scope: Test lifecycle repair only; no product behavior, mocking boundaries, Vitest error reporting, assertions, or build configuration changed.

hypotheses.cause: React roots remain mounted because RTL auto-cleanup requires global afterEach and Vitest globals are disabled
hypotheses.prediction: Explicit cleanup must detach the App storage listener and stop subsequent effect-triggered work before imports drain.
hypotheses.evidence: tests/unit/popup-claim-recovery.test.tsx had no cleanup/unmount; tests/setup.ts has no cleanup hook; vitest.config.ts does not enable globals; node_modules/@testing-library/react/dist/index.js guards automatic cleanup by typeof afterEach.

hypotheses.cause: Awaiting separate mocked view imports does not cover all imports/effect work started by App
hypotheses.prediction: Unmount plus vi.dynamicImportSettled in afterEach keeps all runner-tracked resolving/evaluating imports within the live test environment, including assertion failures.
hypotheses.evidence: Real CI fails despite the two explicit imports; node_modules/vitest/dist/chunks/utils.BX5Fg8C4.js waitForImportsToResolve recursively checks resolvingModules and unevaluated module promises.

hypotheses.prediction: Existing quarantine, explicit Open Scrape routing and consumed-intent assertions would fail.
hypotheses.evidence: They pass in actual failed CI, so this does not explain the observed unhandled error.

change: afterEach first calls RTL cleanup, then awaits vi.dynamicImportSettled, then clears test launch-intent storage and restores spies. Removed the inadequate two body-only view import waits. All five original behavioral expectations retained.

sibling_census.result: popup-claim-recovery is the only sidepanel App test renderer. App prewarms every tab through one VIEW_LOADERS effect; teardown drains all tracked imports rather than listing Chat and Scrape.
sibling_census.adjacent: popup-capture-route, popup-panel-remedy and popup-auth-error import popup/main, which uses createRoot and no dynamic import expressions. They are not members of the observed sidepanel lazy-import class. Their root ownership is a separate lifecycle concern and was not modified.

performed: Fetched actual CI failure and head SHA via gh
Inspected installed RTL and Vitest lifecycle implementations
Source diff preserves every original behavioral expectation
not_performed: No runtime, test, build or browser execution per owner guard
required_owner_runs: Focused popup-claim-recovery test repeatedly, including ordinary and deliberately failing assertion paths in an isolated scratch copy to verify teardown still runs
Full pnpm test under CI maxWorkers=2
Actual remote CI containing repair before defect closure

limits: The missing cleanup and incomplete import barrier are source-established lifecycle defects. Whether they fully explain this intermittent CI race remains unverified until owner execution; do not mark D20 fixed or closed from this report.
